name: Hadamard slides along a cup
summary: A Hadamard on one leg of a cup (or cap) can be moved to the other leg.
description:
The Hadamard gate is symmetric (equal to its own transpose), so it can slide along a cup or cap from one leg to the other. In axiomatisations in which [cups are spiders](../cup-as-spider/) this follows from the [colour change rule](../colour-change/), but Ng and Wang state it as an axiom. It is equivalent to [the Hadamard being self-transpose](../hadamard-transpose/), the form used in the LICS'18 paper of Hadzihasanovic, Ng and Wang.

In PyZX and ZXLive inputs and outputs are determined by their position, so a bare cup cannot be drawn directly.
unchecked_reason: a bare cup (a wire whose two ends are both outputs) cannot be represented with ZXLive-style boundaries
